deployment_config:
# The New Fuse - Deployment Configuration
# This file contains default configuration for automated deployments

# Deployment Strategy
# Options: rolling, blue-green, canary
DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY=rolling

# Environment
# Options: development, staging, production
ENVIRONMENT=production

# Build Configuration
SKIP_TESTS=false
SKIP_MIGRATIONS=false
SKIP_VALIDATION=false

# Rollback Configuration
AUTO_ROLLBACK=true
ROLLBACK_ON_SMOKE_TEST_FAILURE=true

# Database Configuration
BACKUP_BEFORE_MIGRATE=true
COMPRESS_BACKUPS=true
BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS=30
BACKUP_RETENTION_COUNT=10

# Notification Configuration
ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS=true
SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=https://hooks.slack.com/services/placeholder

# Health Check Configuration
HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT=30
HEALTH_CHECK_RETRY_COUNT=3
HEALTH_CHECK_RETRY_DELAY=5

# CloudRuntime Configuration
CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROJECT_ID=the-new-fuse-2025
CLOUD_RUNTIME_ENVIRONMENT=production
WAIT_FOR_CLOUD_RUNTIME_DEPLOY=true
WATCH_CLOUD_RUNTIME_LOGS=false

# Service Configuration
SERVICES=api-gateway,backend,frontend,api

# Service URLs (will be auto-populated after deployment)
API_GATEWAY_URL=https://api.thenewfuse.com
BACKEND_URL=https://api.thenewfuse.com
FRONTEND_URL=https://thenewfuse.com
API_URL=https://api.thenewfuse.com

# Zero-Downtime Configuration
ENABLE_ZERO_DOWNTIME=true
GRADUAL_TRAFFIC_SHIFT=true
TRAFFIC_SHIFT_INTERVAL=30
CANARY_PERCENTAGE=10

# Monitoring Configuration
ENABLE_MONITORING=true
METRICS_ENDPOINT=/metrics
HEALTH_ENDPOINT=/health

# Security Configuration
ALLOW_BREAKING_CHANGES=false
REQUIRE_APPROVAL=false
ALLOW_TEST_FAILURES=false

# Performance Configuration
BUILD_MEMORY_LIMIT=4096
BUILD_CONCURRENCY=4
PARALLEL_DEPLOYMENTS=false

# Logging Configuration
LOG_LEVEL=info
VERBOSE_LOGGING=false
